Summarize a cate_result object

Source: R/user-dnn-cate-methods.R
summary.cate_result.Rd

Summarize a cate_result object

Usage

# S3 method for class 'cate_result'
summary(object, level = 0.95, ...)

Arguments

object

A cate_result object from cate_dnn().

level

Confidence level used for interval columns.

...

Not used.

Value

An object of class summary.cate_result with a coefficient table.

Examples

set.seed(1)
n <- 30
x_mat <- matrix(rnorm(n * 2), n, 2)
out <- cate_dnn(X = x_mat, x0 = c(0, 0), pseudo_outcome = rnorm(n))
summary(out)
#> <summary.cate_result>
#>   localization: s = 5, s/n = 0.167
#>   targets: 1
#>          estimate std.error statistic p.value conf.low conf.high
#> target_1   0.2394    0.2734    0.8758  0.3811  -0.2964    0.7753
